# SEOShouts.com
> Free SEO Tools & Professional SEO Services

SEOShouts is founded by Rohit Sharma, an SEO expert with 13+ years of experience in technical SEO, content strategy, and search optimization. Co-founded by Ajay Porwal. Based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India, serving India, the USA, and global clients.

SEOShouts focuses on the technical implementation layer of SEO and AI search (AEO/GEO): free, in-browser SEO tools plus hands-on implementation guides.

## Flagship Tools
- [Internal Link Checker](https://seoshouts.com/tools/internal-link-checker/) - Crawls up to 500 pages; unique anchor-text word cloud plus an internal PageRank and orphan-pages report
- [On-Page SEO Analyzer](https://seoshouts.com/tools/on-page-seo-analyzer/) - 150+ ranking factors with the real Google PageSpeed API
- [GEO/AEO Checker](https://seoshouts.com/tools/geo-aeo-checker/) - Scores AI-search readiness 0-100 across 7 weighted categories with live robots.txt and llms.txt checks
- [Schema Generator](https://seoshouts.com/tools/schema-generator/) - 39+ schema types, the most comprehensive free generator
